$comment: Axis J: the models offered. An entry with a `policy` has been measured and runs with it; one without runs on the defaults and is shown as unmeasured. Each entry: id, name, url, sizeBytes, sha256, and optionally policy: load (cachePrecision, memoryBudget, rollbackReserve, stop — the stop tokens' texts beyond the file's), sampling per mode ({ temperature, topK, topP, minP }), and template variables. A model that embeds also carries prompts: { query, document }, the task prompts its card gives, written before each text (web/task_prompt.js); they are the card's, not a measurement, so they do not make a model measured. A model whose images are encoded by a companion file carries vision: { url, sizeBytes, ranges, rangesSha256, tokens }, the ranges a load reads and their hash pinned by tools/pin_ranges.py (web/catalog.js). Contract 12 in docs/architecture/file-mapping.md; the C++ side is src/core/policy/policy.h.
